subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Land Rover engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the TDV8 SDV8 across its Land Rover applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The TDV8 and SDV8 are V8 diesel engines fitted across Discovery, Range Rover and Range Rover Sport — we see them across multiple generations and both 3.6L and 4.4L capacities.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain assembly, main and connecting rod bearings, oil cooler gaskets, and complete gasket and seal set as standard on every rebuild. Application-dependent components (3.6L vs 4.4L) are confirmed once your exact model is verified.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The 3.6 TDV8 is known for timing chain tensioner issues on early L322 models. The 4.4 SDV8 is more durable but has known HP fuel pump failures and turbocharger failures (circa 120k miles). EGR valve sticking and auxiliary belt tensioner weakness are also confirmed issues.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed TDV8 SDV8 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: LAND ROVER TDV8 SDV8 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The TDV8/SDV8 is a more complex engine than the V6, with additional components requiring careful handling. The 3.6L TDV8 is known for timing chain tensioner issues on early models; the 4.4 SDV8 (448DT) is considered more durable. Turbos are a known weak point on both variants, and HP fuel pump failure is a known issue on SDV8s. A full rebuild includes inspection of all wear components and replacement of worn parts to original specification.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, oil cooler gaskets, plus turbo inspection and HP fuel pump inspection on SDV8 variants
